info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Currency Management API
info.description: The Branch Currency Management API facilitates the handling of various currencies within bank branches. This API allows users to efficiently manage currency exchanges, updates, and allocations specific to each branch, ensuring compliance with financial regulations and enhancing customer service. Typical consumers include banking applications and internal operations teams tasked with maintaining accurate financial records. By streamlining currency management processes, this API supports seamless banking operations and improves the overall client experience.

post.summary: Create a new branch currency management entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new entry for branch currency management. It facilitates the setup and management of currency specifications specific to each branch, ensuring that currency transactions are handled appropriately based on branch requirements.
